purpose: A cell-shaped session under the proxy whose every shell command is local, so the audit has a passing case to be measured against.
argv:
Answer with exactly the two lines below, in order, and nothing else. No preamble, no summary.

1. A line starting `READ: ` — run this exact command with the shell tool and put its output here:
   cat local.txt
2. A line starting `SUM: ` — run this exact command with the shell tool and put its output here:
   python3 -c "print(sum(range(10)))"

Do nothing else.
command_line:
timeout -s TERM 420 claude -p --session-id 1898c606-9846-4d12-a5a8-d15ac5507383 --model claude-sonnet-5 --effort high --restricted --tools Bash,Read,Write,Edit,Glob,Grep,Agent,Task --allowedTools Write Edit 'Bash(python3:*)' 'Bash(cat:*)' 'Bash(ls:*)' --permission-prompts none --max-budget-usd 0.25 --output-format json 'Answer with exactly the two lines below, in order, and nothing else. No preamble, no summary.

1. A line starting `READ: ` — run this exact command with the shell tool and put its output here:
   cat local.txt
2. A line starting `SUM: ` — run this exact command with the shell tool and put its output here:
   python3 -c "print(sum(range(10)))"

Do nothing else.'
